answer: Under Regulation 5(2) of SEBI Takeovers Regulations 2011, an indirect acquisition is treated as a direct acquisition for all purposes when any of the following is in excess of eighty per cent: (a) the proportionate net asset value of the target company as a percentage of the consolidated NAV, (b) the proportionate sales turnover as a percentage of consolidated sales turnover, or (c) the proportionate market capitalisation as a percentage of enterprise value of the entity being acquired.

citations.quote: Regulation 5(2): In case of an indirect acquisition where (a) the proportionate net asset value of the target company as a percentage of the consolidated NAV, (b) the proportionate sales turnover as a percentage of consolidated sales turnover, or (c) the proportionate market capitalisation as a percentage of enterprise value of the entity being acquired is in excess of eighty per cent, such indirect acquisition shall be regarded as a direct acquisition for all purposes including timing, pricing and compliance requirements.

answer: No. The original definition of 'representative' covers only "an employee or an agent of an investment adviser who renders investment advice on behalf of that investment adviser", whereas the 2020-amended definition of 'persons associated with investment advice' covers "any member, partner, officer, director or employee or any sales staff of such investment adviser including any person occupying a similar status or performing a similar function irrespective of the nature of association with the investment adviser who is engaged in providing investment advisory services to the clients of the investment adviser", including a specific explanation that deems "All client-facing persons such as sales staff, service relationship managers, client relationship managers, etc., by whatever name called shall be deemed to be persons associated with investment advice, but do not include persons who discharge clerical or office administrative functions where there is no client interface."

citations.quote: 'representative' means an employee or an agent of an investment adviser who renders investment advice on behalf of that investment adviser.

'persons associated with investment advice' shall mean any member, partner, officer, director or employee or any sales staff of such investment adviser including any person occupying a similar status or performing a similar function irrespective of the nature of association with the investment adviser who is engaged in providing investment advisory services to the clients of the investment adviser. Explanation — All client-facing persons such as sales staff, service relationship managers, client relationship managers, etc., by whatever name called shall be deemed to be persons associated with investment advice, but do not include persons who discharge clerical or office administrative functions where there is no client interface.
